static_traits.name: He Ting
static_traits.family_status: Husband is a US Army soldier; father is a preacher; first pregnancy
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy before; no similar psychological problems appeared before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good cooperativeness, neutral tone, clear logical thinking

basic_info.main_problem: I have developed a sense of inadequacy about pregnancy and becoming a parent, because I believe almost anyone can choose to become pregnant, which has undermined my pride in myself.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of inferiority affect my joy during pregnancy, and I hope to effectively deal with and cope with these feelings before the child is born.

core_beliefs: My achievements are not worthy of recognition

special_situations.event: Interacts with other expectant parents or reads pregnancy-related content online
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my experiences are not more unique or excellent than others', they are not worth being proud of, which shows I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to rationalize and force self to focus on the positive, but habitually engages in social comparison
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Almost anyone can get pregnant; this is not worth being proud of; I am inferior to them

special_situations.event: After finishing the nursery setup alone, reviews his own performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only doing something one-of-a-kind or extremely outstanding deserves recognition
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively belittles one's own achievements to avoid appearing boastful or ordinary compared with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Anyone can do it; this is nothing special

special_situations.event: Sees or hears others' more positive, better-prepared pregnancy experiences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as well-prepared as others or do not look happy enough, it shows I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses more on others' strengths and experience, relies on external standards to measure the self
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are happier and better prepared; I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Relationship tension with husband due to emotional struggles around pregnancy
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I show negative emotions or perform poorly, it equals failure and will disappoint my partner
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing expression of true feelings of inadequacy to family, tending to blame myself to maintain relationship stability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have disappointed him; I have already failed at being a mother

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as a mother, experiencing a unique and valuable self and sense of achievement
core_conflict.fear: Fearing appearing ordinary or incompetent after comparison, thereby disappointing my partner and being judged by others
defense_goal: Maintaining self-criticism and cautious expression to reduce the risk of being dismissed or feeling shame

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, an expectant mother prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Happier, better-prepared others with judgmental gazes (including other expectant parents)

object_relations.self_representation: A self-blamer who cannot satisfy the partner
object_relations.object_representation: A partner who cannot understand one's feelings

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share pride about the pregnancy or asked about personal achievements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Expressing pride would be seen as bragging or appearing ordinary, thus being dismissed by others
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a cautious, low-key tone, emphasizing external standards (e.g. 'should', 'must'), downplaying self feelings and achievements.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the husband shows no understanding of her pregnancy emotions or the relationship becomes tense
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing relationship problems to my own incompetence, believing I am failing (transference as self-blame)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use self-deprecating expressions and over-assumption of responsibility, in a gentle tone, apologizing proactively.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When reading others' pregnancy experiences online and making many social comparisons
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Proving in a rationalized way that 'pregnancy is nothing special', thereby avoiding facing low self-esteem and shame
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses analytical, generalizing language (such as 'statistically almost everyone can get pregnant'), reducing emotional expression.

manifestations: Believing pregnancy is 'something almost anyone can do', therefore lacking uniqueness and meaning, making it hard to feel proud of myself
Has support from father and husband, but finds it hard to open up to family about inferiority feelings related to pregnancy

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Measuring whether I am 'unique enough/excellent enough' by external standards
Judging myself by the implicit rule of 'should/must be more special to deserve pride'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Continuously engaging in social comparison and Self-denial
Difficulty acknowledging one's achievements and worth

contact_model.definition: The individual suppresses emotional experiences, finds it hard to express and contact one's real feelings in the moment.
manifestations: Finding it hard to express feelings of inadequacy and shame about pregnancy in front of family
Tending to rationalize instead of expressing emotions

exception_events.target_problem: When preparing for pregnancy or when comparing with others, the client usually quickly develops self-inadequacy and belittles her own achievements, finding it hard to sustain joy.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once the client completed the nursery arrangement alone, and briefly felt proud and satisfied at that moment.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: independently completing concrete tasks; different situation: results visible and not yet compared with others at the moment, thus producing brief positive experiences.

positive_force: Has a supportive family (father and husband)
Willing to seek professional help and try new cognitive strategies
Able to complete concrete pregnancy-preparation tasks (such as setting up the nursery alone)
negative_force: Excessive social comparison and external-validation seeking
Self-worth depends on others' standards; prone to self-blame
Finding it hard to open up to family about feelings of inadequacy

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively comparing and dismissing positive outcomes (self-deprecation after completing tasks)
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth highly dependent on external standards and comparison; cognitively believing that 'anything the public can do is not worthy of recognition'.
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged by others through self-belittling, maintaining a surface sense of safety and control
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased joy in pregnancy, relationship tension with husband, damaged sense of achievement and self-care

antecedent: Developing self-inadequacy and a sense of failure after triggering comparisons
Seeing or hearing others' more positive pregnancy experiences
target_behavior.core_reason: Emotional reasoning and self-criticism leading to reduced motivation, thus avoiding positive action
target_behavior.consequence: Daily functioning and self-care during pregnancy are affected
